stories.title: Offshore wind farm approved for site off Peterhead
stories.summary: The Scottish government says its consent comes with a number of conditions.

stories.title: Scotland's 'mansion tax' law a step closer as bill published
stories.summary: Holyrood ministers are proposing a large council tax hike on homes worth more than £1m.

stories.title: Human bones found during renovation of Ayrshire bandstand
stories.summary: A picture sent to BBC Scotland News showed several bones lying on the ground at the site.

stories.title: NHS Highland's handling of child health visit concerns criticised
stories.summary: A watchdog said the health board did not fully address concerns raised by a whistleblower.

stories.title: Communist who planned attacks on police and army jailed
stories.summary: Sean Grant, 22, was arrested after police found hand-written documents with detailed plans in his Musselburgh home.

stories.title: Surgeon calls for corporate homicide probe over claims patients unnecessarily bled to death
stories.summary: Dr Mohammed Habib said he had been raising concerns about NHS Grampian for a decade, including with government ministers and police.

stories.title: Mothballed Scottish spaceport helps inspire new BBC sci-fi thriller
stories.summary: Sutherland is set in the Scottish Highlands and deep space, with its first episodes expected next year.

stories.title: Missing person winched from coastal rocks in helicopter rescue
stories.summary: A rescue operation sees one person airlifted to safety from the rocks north of Loch Ryan.

stories.title: Benedetti to stay on as Edinburgh International Festival director
stories.summary: The violinist says she needs more time to continue the work she began when she was appointed four year ago.

stories.title: Gilts v kilts: What is happening with Scottish government bonds?
stories.summary: MSPs have heard both the pros and cons of the government's plan to launch its first ever bond to the market.

stories.title: Falkirk's Cladhan Hotel closes permanently to asylum seekers
stories.summary: The hotel was the site of several heated demonstrations last summer which led to multiple arrests.

stories.title: 'No rescue required' as boat found partially sunk off Orkney
stories.summary: The wreck, which has not been formally identified, was reported at about 10:30 and the coastguard sent an aircraft to inspect the site.
